homepageTopArticles.title: Gorilla Commerce built a 9-figure business on Amazon. Now, it’s launching in Walmart stores
homepageTopArticles.snippet: Gorilla Commerce, most well-known for its slip-resistant bath mats, has found tremendous success primarily through Amazon, surpassing nine figures in sales. But the company wants to prove it's more than just an Amazon brand. Two years ago, it launched on Walmart's marketplace, and last month, the company brought Gorilla Grip to more than 2,600 Walmart stores.
